title: Tech Revolution: Local Startup Launches AI-Powered HR Platform
description:
In a groundbreaking move for Sri Lanka’s digital landscape, Talentfort (Pvt) Ltd has unveiled a next-generation AI-driven Human Resource Information System (HRIS) designed to automate employee management, payroll processing, and performance analytics.

Colombo, October 9, 2025 — The launch event at Colombo Innovation Hub drew attention from tech enthusiasts, HR professionals, and investors eager to see how artificial intelligence could redefine workforce management.

Key Highlights:
  1. 🤖 Smart Attendance Tracking: Integrated facial recognition and biometric verification for real-time attendance.
  2. 📊 Automated Payroll: Instant payroll generation with tax and EPF/ETF calculations.
  3. 💬 Employee Portal: Secure mobile access for payslips, leave applications, and performance dashboards.

The company’s CEO stated:

“Our goal is to empower organizations with data-driven insights and smarter automation tools that enhance both efficiency and employee satisfaction.”

Looking Ahead:

Talentfort aims to expand its product portfolio across Asia by 2026, with features like predictive analytics for attrition and AI-assisted recruitment screening.
